Ambient zyada

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and let it cool; do not restart until the temperature has dropped
solutions.ur: Unit OFF karein aur thanda hone dein; temperature kam hone tak restart na karein

solutions.en: Clean the fans and heatsink fins, blow out the dust and confirm the fans really spin while the unit runs
solutions.ur: Fans aur heatsink ki fins saaf karein, dhool nikalein aur unit chalte waqt fans sach much ghoomne par nazar rakhein

solutions.en: Keep ambient air within the rating and the vents unblocked; if a fan does not run, replace it
solutions.ur: Aas paas ka hawa rating ke andar rakhein aur vent block na hon; koi fan na chale to use badlein
